notes.title: FOGLIGHT ONLINE (Multiplayer) OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517520/Foglight_Online/]STEAM STORE[/url][/b][/h2]

Foglight Online is a 1 v 6 player horror multiplayer game where one player takes the role of Farberto and the other players must find a way to escape or fight back! While in Early Access the game will be FREE to download.

[previewyoutube=sfpFEnKGOvE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1517520/extras/Smell.gif?t=1611604702[/img]
The gameplay focuses heavily on the idea of players having a "scent" that Farberto can follow. Players must use this to their advantage. 


[b]Featuring map design facelift[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38956754/c235cd1c0b1b98f8ba9a2eb45f097956b07028ac.png[/img]

Foglight Online will launch with 2 maps. The Lighthouse Island and the Caves. The maps have been overhaled to look better and include more destructible environment elements then the original.

tags.feature: Foglight Online will launch with 2 maps.

notes.title: 1.01 Small Update
notes.content:
UPDATES: 

-Distance Field Shadowing has been turned on to remove the hard edges the lights were casting. 

-Overall exposure has been dropped to make the flashlight a more necessary tool.

-Bug on Farberto where walk animation was used while he was running has been fixed.

-Farberto growls more often.
